purpose: Reconcile the Wave 478 workspace/network candidate with the Wave 488 source-verified standard runner catalog. This remains a proposal and does not authorize workflow dispatch, agent execution, provider calls, credential access, or deployment.

repository.concurrency_reference_note: Published Free-plan baseline only; not evidence of this account's subscription, available slots, or reserved capacity.

runner_catalog.label: ubuntu-24.04
runner_catalog.role: Primary candidate for general-purpose CI, read-only engineering tasks, static analysis and CPU-compatible small-model experiments.

runner_catalog.label: ubuntu-24.04-arm
runner_catalog.role: Architecture-native tests and ARM-compatible runtime qualification.

runner_catalog.label: macos-26
runner_catalog.gpu: Integrated Apple GPU; accelerator entitlement/performance NOT_VERIFIED
runner_catalog.role: Specialist Apple Silicon compatibility and bounded MLX/Metal qualification only.

isolation.vm_lifecycle: Fresh VM per non-slim standard hosted job; VM is decommissioned after job completion.
isolation.workspace_scope: Job-local; may be shared between steps in one job only.
isolation.cross_job_exchange: Explicit bounded artifacts or source-control commits; no implicit shared filesystem.
isolation.token_permissions: contents:read by default; no write permission in this target profile.
isolation.secret_handling: No provider credentials in source, task envelope, prompts, workspace artifacts, caches or logs. Runtime secret access remains separately gated and was not performed.
isolation.cleanup: Runner VM disposal is platform lifecycle behavior; artifact/cache retention and deletion policy remain NOT_VERIFIED.
isolation.self_hosted_runners: Excluded. Self-hosted node identities and authority classes MUST NOT be merged into this hosted runner catalog.

network.egress_model: Direct outbound HTTPS only, subject to separately accepted destination policy.
network.source_ip: Dynamic/shared; no stable source IP assumed.
network.fixed_ip_exception: A destination requiring source-IP allowlisting is incompatible until a separately approved target is selected.
network.destination_allowlist_enforcement: NOT_VERIFIED for standard hosted runner network layer; provider-connected execution remains BLOCKED.
network.inbound_listener: Not required; no public inbound listener.
network.peer_network: No guaranteed direct runner-to-runner reachability, bandwidth, latency, packet-loss SLA or shared private network.
network.artifact_relay: Allowed as a bounded evidence/result handoff candidate only; must not be described as peer-to-peer throughput.
network.model_sharding: NOT_QUALIFIED; no production tensor/pipeline sharding across standard hosted runners.

compute_constraints.standard_linux_windows_gpu: No documented GPU entitlement in the reviewed standard runner matrix.
compute_constraints.macos_accelerator: Integrated Apple GPU is not treated as guaranteed accelerator capacity; Metal/MLX availability and performance require runtime qualification.
compute_constraints.large_model_inference: Not assumed feasible from CPU/RAM catalog alone; per-model compatibility and memory tests required.
compute_constraints.persistent_gui: NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_EPHEMERAL_JOB_LIFECYCLE; persistent desktop access requires a separately governed worker class and is outside this manifest.

dispatch.controller_task_acceptance: Current Gemini controller fixed task profiles do not accept this manifest-reconciliation packet.
admission_gates: A0 issuer/ingress/lease/cancel/recovery contract accepted after independent A3 review
R-06 audit/privacy authority and retention policy accepted
Destination-level egress enforcement and data policy accepted
Exact workflow SHA, runner target and task profile independently reviewed
Draft 2020-12 schema validation with format assertions and positive/negative fixtures accepted
Task identity, capability, quota, expiry, revocation and evidence lifecycle accepted
Actual account plan, effective concurrency and artifact retention policy verified

qualification_plan.pilot_scope: One immutable non-secret read-only job on the default Ubuntu x64 profile after all admission gates pass.
measurements: Runner image, OS version, architecture, CPU, available memory and disk
Queue delay, job duration and teardown result
At least five bounded transfer samples to an explicitly approved neutral endpoint
At least five GitHub artifact upload/download samples between two isolated jobs
Median, p95, failures, payload size and measurement endpoint
Artifact digest, retention and deletion evidence
No provider/model inference until its separate destination and data-policy gate passes
prohibited: Multi-GB model transfers as initial probe
Direct peer listeners or inbound ports
